title: Disney Around the Globe
intro: [excited] Grab your passport and your neck pillow, everybody! Tonight we're leaving Florida and California behind and hopping between Paris, Tokyo, Hong Kong and Shanghai. [laughs] No jet lag allowed!

art.prompt: A glowing night skyline mashup of fantasy theme park icons from around the world: a pink-spired fairy-tale castle, a smoking volcano over a harbor, a glass-roofed Victorian arcade and red paper lanterns, all connected by dotted airplane flight paths across a vintage world map Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Try Everything
categories.intro: Shanghai Disneyland opened a whole land based on Zootopia, so our film category is going full mammal. [chuckles] Sloths, please answer quickly.

art.prompt: A sleek futuristic animal city skyline with a rainforest district, a snowy tundra district and a desert district side by side under a sunrise, a tiny carrot-shaped pen and a police badge on a ledge in the foreground Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Zootopia's hero Judy Hopps, the city's first officer of her kind, is this kind of animal.
clues.reveal: [cheerful] The correct answer is a rabbit! Judy proves that a little bunny can be a big cop. [laughs] Just don't call her cute.

clues.clue: Judy grew up on a carrot farm in this rural hometown, far from the big city.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Bunnyburrow! [chuckles] Population: a whole lot of bunnies, and growing every minute.

clues.clue: Shakira voices this pop-star gazelle who sings Try Everything.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Gazelle! And Benjamin Clawhauser is her number one fan. [laughs] He has the app and everything.

clues.clue: This no-nonsense Cape buffalo is the chief of the Zootopia Police Department.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Chief Bogo! [laughs] He puts Judy on parking duty on day one. Rough first day at the office.

clues.clue: Zootopia land opened at Shanghai Disneyland in December of this year, the first land of its kind in the world.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is 2023! Shanghai got the world's first Zootopia land, with a trackless ride called Zootopia: Hot Pursuit. True Disney nerd points!

categories.title: Only Over There
categories.intro: These lands and rides exist only outside the United States. [whispers] Sorry, Florida.

art.prompt: A world traveler's scrapbook spread open on a desk with illustrated sketches of an exotic harbor, a retro-futurist brass rocket, a Victorian mansion, a gold-rush mine town and a pirate galleon, plus a stack of foreign coins Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Instead of Main Street, U.S.A., Shanghai Disneyland welcomes you on this street named after a very famous mouse.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Mickey Avenue! Shanghai skipped the small-town America theme and went straight to the main mouse.

clues.clue: Disneyland Paris swaps Tomorrowland for this retro-futuristic land inspired by Jules Verne and H.G. Wells.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Discoveryland! [excited] Brass rockets, submarines and big dreamers of Europe. Very steampunk, very French.

clues.clue: Shanghai Disneyland's Pirates of the Caribbean ride has this subtitle, with an epic underwater battle.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Battle for the Sunken Treasure! Huge screens plus real sets. You ride right under the sea with Jack Sparrow.

clues.clue: In Tokyo DisneySea, this port is home to the smoking volcano Mount Prometheus and Journey to the Center of the Earth.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mysterious Island! [whispers] It's Captain Nemo's secret base. And yes, the volcano really erupts.

clues.clue: Hong Kong Disneyland's gold-rush land, home of Big Grizzly Mountain Runaway Mine Cars, is called this.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is Grizzly Gulch! A Wild West boomtown in Hong Kong, with a coaster that runs backwards. [laughs] Hold on to your hat!

categories.title: Postcards from Abroad
categories.intro: Real photos from Disney parks overseas. Tell me where in the world you are! [chuckles] No peeking at your passport stamps.

art.prompt: A wire rack of blank vintage postcards spinning in a souvenir shop window, sunlight streaming in, with a world globe, a compass and an airplane ticket stub nearby Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This castle, the biggest Disney has ever built, is the centerpiece of the Disney park in which city?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Shanghai! The Enchanted Storybook Castle opened with the park in 2016, and it's honoring every Disney princess.

clues.clue: This glass-roofed shopping street replaces Main Street, U.S.A. at which park? It keeps shoppers dry on rainy days.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tokyo Disneyland! It's called World Bazaar. [laughs] Rain or shine, the shopping never stops.

clues.clue: This rocky volcano, which rumbles and erupts, is the icon of which Disney park?
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Tokyo DisneySea! That's Mount Prometheus. The park opened in 2001 and fans call it one of the most beautiful parks on Earth.

clues.clue: Name this Hong Kong Disneyland attraction, where a monkey named Albert opens a magic music box and brings a whole house to life.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mystic Manor! [chuckles] Lord Henry Mystic's collection goes wild, all to a Danny Elfman score. No ghosts, just mischief.

clues.clue: This glowing lightcycle coaster debuted in 2016 at which park, seven years before Magic Kingdom got its own version?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Shanghai Disneyland! TRON Lightcycle Power Run opened there first. Magic Kingdom's twin arrived in 2023.

source.author: Jeremy Thompson from Los Angeles, California

categories.title: Grand Openings Abroad
categories.intro: When did the castle gates swing open overseas? [laughs] Dust off your history books.

art.prompt: A giant ceremonial gold ribbon and oversized scissors in front of a fairy-tale castle gate, confetti and fireworks bursting in the sky, flags of many nations fluttering Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: The very first Disney park outside the United States opened in 1983 in this country.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Japan! Tokyo Disneyland opened on April 15, 1983. Konnichiwa, Mickey!

clues.clue: When it opened in 1992, Disneyland Paris went by this name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Euro Disneyland! [chuckles] The name changed in the 1990s. Paris just sounded more magical.

clues.clue: Hong Kong Disneyland opened its gates on Lantau Island in this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2005! Opening day was September 12, 2005, and in 2023 it added the world's first World of Frozen.

clues.clue: Disney does not own Tokyo Disney Resort. It's owned and run by this Japanese company, which licenses the magic from Disney.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is the Oriental Land Company! That's why Tokyo's parks feel so unique. They do things their own way.

clues.clue: In 2026, Disneyland Paris's second park, Walt Disney Studios Park, reopened under this new name.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Disney Adventure World! The rename arrived with the park's own World of Frozen. True globe-trotter points!

categories.title: Snack Passport
categories.intro: Our fan category is all about the treats you can only eat overseas. [laughs] Bring stretchy pants.

art.prompt: A colorful street-food spread on a wooden counter: buckets of popcorn in many flavors, a bubbly golden egg waffle, a long dumpling-stuffed bun and a little bowl of ratatouille, with paper lanterns overhead Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Tokyo Disney Resort is famous for selling this snack in flavors like curry, honey, and soy sauce and butter.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is popcorn! Fans hop from cart to cart collecting flavors. [laughs] Curry popcorn. Don't knock it till you try it.

clues.clue: Hong Kong Disneyland makes a Mickey-shaped version of this bubbly, crispy Hong Kong street-food treat.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the egg waffle! [chuckles] Little golden bubbles you can pull apart. Pure happiness on a stick.

clues.clue: Tokyo DisneySea's cult-favorite Mysterious Island snack stuffs dumpling filling into a long bun. It's called this.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is the Gyoza Dog! Half hot dog, half dumpling, all delicious. The line is part of the experience.

clues.clue: In Paris, Remy's Ratatouille Adventure exits into this restaurant, where diners feel rat-sized among giant plates and bottles.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Bistrot Chez Remy! [whispers] Try the ratatouille. Obviously. It opened in 2014.

clues.clue: Tokyo DisneySea opened this port in 2024, with lands themed to Frozen, Tangled and Peter Pan.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Fantasy Springs! The park's eighth port, with its own luxury hotel. Arendelle, Rapunzel's forest and Never Land, all in one place.
